subject: July pipeline scrub — leadership pack owners & stage responses needed
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: July pipeline scrub — leadership pack owners & stage responses needed

Team / Maya,

Running the monthly/QBR scrub next week — goal is a clean leadership pack we can hand to Finance and GTM leadership on Monday 7/26. Key asks:

- Managers: fill the pipeline_stage_template.xlsx (attached) for all active deals with commit/forecast stages by EOD Tue 7/20. Indicate confidence (High/Med/Low) and any gating risks.
- Leadership pack owners (Markus + Laura): I need the 1-pg deal narrative for each commit by Thu 7/22 so we can assemble slides.
- Karthik: compile roll-up numbers per region and a short variance note vs last month (slide-ready numbers) by Fri 7/23.
- Maya / AtlasHealth: please confirm expected PO date for the committed line items in the attached spreadsheet so we can lock revenue recognition timing.

Attachments: pipeline_stage_template.xlsx, QBR_leadership_pack_outline_v0.3.pdf
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bq-example-QBR-pack

I'll run a 30-min sync Mon 7/19 11:00-11:30 to go over any questions — calendar invite to follow. If you cannot hit the deadlines, flag here with the reason and new ETA.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

---

(Attachment stub: pipeline_stage_template.xlsx — spreadsheet with deal id, ARR, stage, confidence, gating reason)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: July pipeline scrub — leadership pack owners & stage responses needed

Monica — thanks for the clear ask. Quick clarifications:

1) For the 1-pg deal narrative, do we have a preferred template (metrics to surface)? I assume: primary use case, close blockers, next milestone, expected PO date, and churn risk.
2) Should managers include pipeline items currently in evaluation (no demo yet), or only deals that are in Demo+ stages?

I'll start pulling narratives for the East region. Markus, can you own San Francisco and Enterprise names? Karthik — happy to sync on the roll-up numbers schema if you want a short call Monday.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Sales Manager — Enterprise
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Agree with the plan. I'll own the leadership slide deck assembly and the exec one-pagers for Enterprise; Laura will feed East narratives into my folder.

Two quick updates/asks:
- Push deadline for the one-pagers to Fri 7/23 EOD. We need a little more time to normalize ARR definitions across the team and avoid last-minute revisions.
- Karthik, can you include a short table in the roll-up showing expected ARR movement if all High-confidence commits land vs. if only Medium+High land? That will help Finance scenario test.

I'll circulate a slide skeleton by Mon evening with placeholders.
